8. Housing Services  
 
1. Summary 
This Report is produced to give an overview of the delivery of the Housing Capital 
Programme and Housing Services at Westmeath County Council. The Report also covers the 
provision, maintenance and management of housing stock and the housing supports 
available for those who need them.  
The Report covers the following areas: 
Housing Capital Delivery 
Construction & Planned Delivery 
Affordable Housing Programme 
Croí Cónaithe Scheme 
Acquisitions & Social Leasing 
Traveller Specific Accommodation 
Housing Support  
Housing Need Assessment 
RAS, Leasing, HAP and Housing Allocations 
Housing Adaptation Grants 
Private Rented Housing Standards  
Local Authority Home Loan Scheme, Mortgage to Rent and the Tenant Purchase Scheme 
Housing Maintenance and Retrofit Scheme 
Homeless Services

3. Housing Capital Programme 
The Housing Section recognises the importance of managing the development process as 
part of the effort to achieve the targets set by the Department of Housing, Local 
Government and Heritage (DHLGH). To this extent, the schemes are closely monitored from 
inception through to completion.  
 
The following tables provide an overview of the different schemes under the Housing 
Construction Capital Programme, their current status and estimated completion date.  
It should be noted that dates indicated for completion are estimates and are subject to 
change.

8. Vacant Property Refurbishment Grant 
The Croí Cónaithe (Towns) Fund in the form of the Vacant Property Refurbishment Grant provides 
further opportunities for people to live in towns and villages in Westmeath through the provision of 
a grant to support the refurbishment of vacant properties, with priority given to areas where the 
level of vacancy or dereliction is high. 
 
As of 31st January 2026: 
 
Number of applications – 388 
 
Funding Issued – 117 
 
Approved (Invoices received and at the legal charge stage) – 25 
 
Approved in Principle (1st Inspection complete and works approved) – 135 
 
Further Information requested – 66 
 
Rejected/withdrawn – 45

The process for applying for the Vacant Property Refurbishment Grant moved to an online portal 
from the 05/01/2026. This will assist to streamline the process for grant applicants.  
 
 
9. Second Hand Acquisitions Programme 
Housing Circular 11/2025 outlines the revised arrangements for social housing second-hand 
acquisitions. Social housing acquisitions will continue to focus on the following priority categories: 
1. Tenancy Sustainment – Tenant in Situ – with more restricted parameters than previous 
years. 
2. Exit from homeless services 
3. People with a disability and older persons requiring urgent housing responses 
4. Buy and Renew acquisitions which tackle vacancy 
 
Acquisitions Update as of 31st January 2026. 
     2 - Purchase completed  
     6 - Sale agreed 
     0 - Offers made  
     0 – Being reviewed for possible purchase 
 
We are currently awaiting confirmation of the Second-Hand Acquisition Budget for 2026, which is 
due to be announced in early February. 
 
 
10. Ongoing Construction Projects  
Ongoing discussions with Developers/Property Owners/AHBs with regard to support for various 
sites throughout the county under Social Housing Leasing Programme: 
 
Ard na Greine, Mullingar –a submission has been made to the Department to deliver a further 2 
turnkey units. Approval already in place to deliver 4 Part V units and 1 Turnkey Unit in this 
development. 
 
Kingscourt, Castlepollard - Currently liaising with developer to deliver 9 units via Part V 
arrangements.  
 
Coola Meadows, Kilbeggan  - Currently liaising with developer to deliver 4 units via Part V 
arrangements. 
 
Clonbrusk, Coosan, Athlone - Currently liaising with developer to deliver 6 units via Part V 
arrangements. 
 
Castlelost, Rochfortbridge - Currently liaising with developer to deliver 1 unit via Part V 
arrangements. 
 
Harbour Meadows, Mullingar - Currently liaising with developer to deliver 7 further units via 
Turnkey arrangements. Part V Agreement already in place to deliver 9 units. 
 
Cornamaddy Athlone – Currently liaising with the developer to deliver a further 3 units via Turnkey 
arrangements. WCC acquired 8  Part V units in the same development in late 2025.

11. Traveller Accommodation 
Blackberry Lane, Athlone - Redevelopment of the site to include 41 new units. Stage 2 approval 
received from the Department in May 2023. This project is currently at preplanning stage. The 
Traveller Accommodation Programme 2025-2029 was adopted by the Elected Members at the 
December Council meeting. 
The Traveller Accommodation Programme target for 2025 for all social housing supports is 26 
households. 20 properties have been allocated to Traveller families. In addition, 10 properties were 
offered but refused and 2 families have found HAP properties. 
 
 
12. Housing Supports and Services 
The Housing Section continues to provide a wide range of Housing Supports to Social Housing 
Applicants to Social Housing Tenants.  Westmeath County Council is currently in the process of 
completing the Summary of Social Housing Assessments (SSHA) under S.21 of the Housing 
(Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 2009 by the deadline of 3rd November 2025.  
 
 
13. Housing Maintenance 
Managing housing maintenance county wide, ensuring value for money while adhering to response 
times set in Tenant handbook. The Housing Department continues to engage with the Department 
regarding various funding programmes.
